lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to shave his head and beard, divide the hair with scales, and burn a third.
Ezekiel is to slash a third with the sword, scatter a third, and throw a few strands into the well.
God says Jerusalem, set among the nations, has rebelled more wickedly than they, so He is against her.
Because they defiled His sanctuary, God will not spare them, and a third will die by flood or famine.
God will make Jerusalem a ruin and a horror to the nations, sending famine, wild beasts, plague and a sword.
